newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai says its GDP rises 9.2 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dubai says its GDP rises 9.2 percent in 1996.

text.p: Dubai's gross domestic product (GDP) at current prices rose 9.2 percent to 41 billion dirhams in 1996, a study by the emirate's Department of Economic Development said on Sunday.
It gave no figure for real GDP growth.
The study put the non-oil sector's contribution to GDP at 81.5 percent in the period.
It said the population expanded 6.2 percent to 716,000 and the workforce rose 6.3 percent to 310,000 in 1996.
Dubai, one of the United Arab Emirates' seven members, is seeking to boost its industrial sector and diversify its economy away from small and falling oil production.
